name: Soul Less
source:
Soul Less is a member of a thief gang living in a cave in the northeastern part of Helman near Golak and Vladivostok. She's the daughter of the old Boss of the group and the sister of [url=/c97952]Bound Less[/url].

She's a passionate and energetic girl, but since she was raised among thieves she's quite violent and tomboyish. She never received a proper education and is mostly illiterate. She's interested in studying but only about things that would be useful for her, such as fighting strategies (though she does show interesting in learning to read after receiving a letter from her brother). She lives a happy and carefree life as a thief. 

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Soul_Less]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
